name: Softwear for WooCommerce
author: TDS

sections.description:
**Overview**

Softwear for WooCommerce is a powerful integration tool developed by TechDog that bridges your WooCommerce store with Softwear’s LatestCollection platform. This plugin ensures smooth and automated data synchronization, enabling you to keep your WooCommerce store up-to-date while simplifying customer and order management.

Key Features

  • Product Catalog Synchronization: Automatically sync product data from the LatestCollection to your WooCommerce store, ensuring product listings are always current.
  • Customer & Order Synchronization: Push customer information and order details from WooCommerce to the LatestCollection for centralized data management.

By seamlessly connecting your WooCommerce store with Softwear’s API, this plugin simplifies workflows and enhances store management.

**How It Works**

Softwear for WooCommerce uses the Softwear API to facilitate the synchronization between WooCommerce and the LatestCollection system. This allows for efficient management of:

  • Products: Automatically update your WooCommerce store with product data from the LatestCollection.
  • Orders: Keep track of order statuses and send updates to the LatestCollection system.
  • Customers: Sync customer information for centralized record-keeping.

To get started, you will need an API key, which can be obtained by contacting TechDog support.

**Setup and Configuration**

  1. Install and Activate the Plugin:

    • Upload the plugin files to your WordPress installation and activate it through the Plugins menu in the WordPress admin.

  2. API Key Configuration:

    • Got to the plugin’s settings page and enter your ApiKey provided by TechDog.
    • Fill in the credentials for the Retail and LatestCollection Api provided by Softwear.
    • Fill in the other settings (Optional).

  3. Begin Syncing:

    • Once configured, the plugin will automatically handle synchronization of your products, orders, and customers.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.3 or later.
  • WooCommerce installed and activated.
  • PHP 7.4 or later.

**Documentation and Support**

Key Resources

  • Softwear API: https://techdog.nl/
  • LatestCollection Website: https://softwear.nl/
  • Terms of Use: https://techdog.nl/unifiedsmb/terms-of-use
  • Privacy Policy: https://techdog.nl/unifiedsmb/privacy-policy

For step-by-step guides and support, visit the TechDog website or contact our team directly.

**Additional Third-Party Service Usage**

This plugin integrates with the Softwear API provided by TechDog via the following endpoint: https://api-softwear.techdogcloud.com/.

Purpose

  • Product Management: The API enables creating, updating, and deleting products in the WooCommerce store.
  • Order Synchronization: Orders placed in WooCommerce are sent back to Softwear for centralized management.
  • Real-Time Stock Updates: Ensures that WooCommerce inventory stays in sync with real-time stock levels managed by Softwear.

Data Usage

  • Data Sent to the API:

    • Product details for creation, update, and deletion.
    • WooCommerce order details.
    • Stock level updates.

  • Data Received from the API:

    • Product data for syncing with WooCommerce.
    • Real-time stock levels for inventory updates.

Service Provider

  • Softwear API is provided by TechDog:
    • Terms of Use
    • Privacy Policy

**Legal and Privacy Considerations**

By using the Softwear for WooCommerce plugin, you agree to the following:
1. Terms of Service: Ensure you comply with the usage terms outlined by TechDog and the LatestCollection provider.
2. Privacy Policy: Understand how your data is processed and protected when interacting with the Softwear API.

We are committed to transparency and compliance with all legal requirements. If you have questions or concerns about data usage or the plugin’s functionality, feel free to contact us at TechDog Support.

**Important Notes**

  • This plugin is developed and maintained by TechDog to enhance WooCommerce integration with Softwear.
  • Using this plugin requires valid API credentials from TechDog.
